whats_new.title: One list for studios and sessions
whats_new.text: Studio now lists every session, whether you chatted in the dashboard or started it in a terminal. Each row has Open and a ... menu with copy resume command, what it changed, run a skill, rules, rename, group, labels, hide and delete. A studio can now run on any model.
